components.summary: A toast is a non-modal message displayed on top of all elements on the screen. It differs from a popup in that it appears in the top right corner of the screen and is not tied to any specific interface element. It is used when no mandatory user response is required (i.e., a modal window is not needed).

Его используют, когда не требуется обязательная реакция пользователя (то есть не нужно модальное окно).
